visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white sleeveless dress, stands on a wooden pier extending into a calm lake. Behind her are majestic mountains under a clear blue sky. She turns her head and smiles warmly at the camera. (2) Close-up shot of a digital flight information board in an airport; a hand enters the frame and points to the destination 'Geneva'. (3) The woman is seen in an airport lounge, sitting in a large beige armchair, waving both hands playfully. (4) She is lying in an airplane bed, tucked under a white duvet with a pillow, eyes closed. (5) An empty city street in Europe is shown with tram tracks running down the center, flanked by classical architecture during early morning. (6) She walks through a lush green meadow wearing black leggings and a dark hiking vest. (7) She sits on a stone wall by the lakeside, holding a book, with the water and distant buildings behind her. (8) She walks towards the entrance of the 'Logitech Daniel Borel Innovation Center', a modern building with large glass windows. (9) Inside the center, a wall displays various color swatches and product designs. She stands next to a female presenter who is gesturing towards a pink keyboard on a desk. (10) A montage of healthy activities: she eats a strawberry, eats a meal at an outdoor table, and drinks from a large water bottle. (11) She is seen in a gym doing pull-ups on a machine, then doing yoga with a group of people on a grassy field near a lake. (12) She hikes a gravel path with a view of the snow-capped Matterhorn peak in the background. (13) In a technical lab, she wears a pink headset and types on a pink keyboard. Sensors are attached to her neck and arm, with a computer monitor showing real-time muscle activity graphs. (14) A man in a light blue shirt holds up paper sketches of ergonomic mice, then shows the physical 'LIFT' mouse. (15) She demonstrates using a black Wave Keys keyboard and the white LIFT mouse. (16) Shots of a 3D printer creating keyboard components and a table covered with numerous prototype mouse models in different colors. (17) She leans over the table of mice, smiling broadly at the camera. (18) She walks away into a meadow and later stands looking at snowy peaks. (19) The video ends with her back on the pier in the white dress, turning to smile as text overlays appear.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: Switzerland 瑞士. (2) [Subtitle]: 飛了九小時. [Logo]: EK181, EK193. (3) [Subtitle]: 轉機十小時. (4) [Subtitle]: 睡死的我 再飛七小時. (5) [Subtitle]: 我終於到瑞士了. (6) [Subtitle]: 這裡真的好山好水 好健康. (7) [Subtitle]: 這次特地來到 Logitech 洛桑總公司. (8) [Subtitle]: 為了就是一探究竟 這個只希望我們更健康的品牌. (9) [Subtitle]: 平常我們有記得吃健康 多喝水 健身 瑜珈 爬山 接近大自然. (10) [Subtitle]: 但那個每天陪伴我們好幾小時的 電腦 滑鼠 鍵盤. (11) [Subtitle]: 就忘了 它就是讓我們肩頸酸痛的 始作俑者. (12) [Subtitle]: Logitech 在產品研發的過程中 透過肌肉壓力測試 找到最舒適的握感. (13) [Subtitle]: 這款白色的是 LIFT 人體工學垂直滑鼠. (14) [Subtitle]: 專為亞洲中小手設計的. (15) [Subtitle]: 握感真的好特別好放鬆喔. (16) [Subtitle]: Wave Keys 人體工學鍵盤. (17) [Subtitle]: 波浪型符合人體工學的設計. (18) [Subtitle]: 一體成型手托可以減少手的壓力. (19) [Subtitle]: 造型也非常簡約好看喔. (20) [Subtitle]: 而且也希望對地球更友善. (21) [Subtitle]: 用更多的回收塑料 用更輕巧的包装. (22) [Subtitle]: 地球健康 人也更健康. (23) [Subtitle]: 人生就是一場馬拉松. (24) [Subtitle]: 每天一點小小的改變 每天就能進步百分之一. (25) [Subtitle]: 持續一年 就會進步三十七倍. (26) [Subtitle]: 兩年 五年 回過頭看. (27) [Subtitle]: 就會感謝那個願意做小小改變的當時的自己. (28) [Slogan]: Small changes, Big impact.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, 1 male presenter, and about 12 people seen in the yoga group and background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long, dark, slightly wavy hair. She is seen in various outfits including a long white sundress, a white t-shirt with denim overalls, and athletic wear like leggings and a hiking vest.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between various scenic outdoor Swiss locations like Lake Geneva and the Matterhorn, airport environments, and the modern, bright Logitech office interiors.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, melodic acoustic guitar track playing in a bright major key. A female narrator with a clear and pleasant Mandarin accent starts speaking at a moderate conversational pace. (2) A subtle digital 'whoosh' sound effect occurs, coinciding with a visual transition. The music continues consistently in the background. (3) Ambient outdoor textures like very faint bird chirping are layered into the mix during the meadow scenes. (4) A crisp, percussive 'click' and 'clack' of mechanical keyboard typing is heard, mixed slightly louder than the background music for emphasis. (5) A rhythmic, high-frequency whirring sound of a 3D printer is audible for a few seconds. (6) The narration becomes more inspirational and energetic towards the end. (7) A final soft 'ding' sound effect marks the appearance of the closing slogan.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Storytelling -> Evidence -> Philosophy -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video promotes Logitech's ergonomic products (LIFT mouse and Wave Keys keyboard) by integrating them into a larger narrative about a healthy, balanced lifestyle. It uses the scenic backdrop of Switzerland and the protagonist's commitment to physical wellness to frame ergonomic computer peripherals as essential tools for long-term health and productivity.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically travels to the Logitech headquarters, interviews staff, tests products in a lab setting, and provides detailed features of the LIFT mouse and Wave Keys keyboard.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A high-quality lifestyle vlog with strong commercial production values, successfully blending travel content with product endorsement.
